{{Quote|Both the mythosaurs and Clan Keldau are long gone, but the skull sigil remains a common symbol of the ''Mando'ade.''|Tor Vizsla|<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mandalorian crest''' was a depiction of a skull of the [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaur]], a traditional symbol<ref name="HotM" /> of the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']]&mdash;the traditional ruler of all the Mandalorian clans&mdash;the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> and of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] themselves.<ref name="HotM" />

[[File:JaingSkull.png|thumb|left|The Mandalorian Crest was first based on the skull of Master Jaing.]]
The skull crest was first used as the sigil of the ancient Mandalorian [[Clan Keldau/Legends|Keldau clan]], renowned for its [[Instructor/Legends|combat trainers]].<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> It originally was adopted to revere a legendary training master named [[Jaing]].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Mandalorian Skull Banner}}</ref> Since the skull of [[Jaing's species]] bears striking resemblance to the skull of a male mythosaur, Mandalorians in modern times recognize the crest as being representative of the latter.<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> Another iteration of the skull icon was combined with the insignia of the Mandalorian Crusaders to form the crest of the later [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]].<ref name="TBHC" /> The Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company known as [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] also used the skull of the mythosaur as the corporation's logo.<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> In [[Time/Legends|time]], the mythosaur skull became a common symbol in Mandalorian society,<ref name="TBHC" /> used to decorate [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]],<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=Republic Elite Forces &ndash; Mandalorians and Omega Squad|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tacREFomega.asp}}</ref><ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref> equipment,<ref name="VoT">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref> and banners.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Some individuals even chose to don the skull sigil as a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]].<ref name="Orders">{{CWACite|4|Orders (comic story)}}</ref>
